def test_cleanup_expired(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            clk = Clock()
            c = DiskCache(d, ttl=10, now=clk)
            c.set("a", 1)
            c.set("b", 2)
            clk.t += 11
            c.get("a") # This should remove 'a'
            self.assertIsNone(c.get("a"))
            self.assertIsNone(c.get("b")) # This should also be removed
            self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(c._path("a")))
            self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(c._path("b")))
